caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figure of a standing person, viewed in profile facing left, with brown skin and black hair styled in a long braid that extends down the back. The figure wears a headdress with multiple feathers, colored red, yellow, and green. Across the upper torso is gray armor or drapery, and a yellow armband is worn on the upper right arm. The skirt is short, flaring out, and alternating between yellow and red, with a darker, possibly black or gray, drapery covering the back. The figure holds a cylindrical black object in its right hand. The figure stands barefoot on a dark rectangular base with step-like features. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, providing contrast to the detailed coloring of the figure.
title: Cigar Store Indian
